section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — IRS Type Rear Suspension
title: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION

content.description: Rear view of car showing bounce direction for stabilizing suspension

content.text: Remove the stands and bounce the car to stabilize the suspension.

content.description: Hand removing stabilizer bar bracket from underside of vehicle

content.text: Remove the nuts, cushions, and links holding both sides of the stabilizer bar from suspension arms, and disconnect the stabilizer bar.

content.description: Hand using wrench to remove stabilizer bar attachment nuts from suspension arm

content.text: 1. ASSEMBLE STABILIZER LINK SUBASSEMBLY AND INSTALL LINK TO ARM

content.description: Exploded view of stabilizer link subassembly showing link, bushings, and washers

content.text: Connect the stabilizer bar on both sides of the link with bolts, collars, cushions and nut.

content.description: Exploded view showing stabilizer bar connection to link with bolts, collars, cushions, and nuts
